meta.note: Magnitude is ML (local magnitude) as reported by EAGP/HKO — NOT converted to Mw, unlike the companion Regional Catalogue (hongkong_historical.json) which uses Mw. Do not mix these two catalogues' magnitudes without accounting for this scale difference. hko_listed=true rows have an independent HKO cross-check location/depth/ML alongside the EAGP value (50 of 484 rows); the rest are EAGP-only. Note on source table symbol: the table's own asterisk '*' footnote ("earthquakes occurred in the territory of Hong Kong, listed by HKO") is a narrower flag than hko_listed here — only 4 rows (Nos. 253, 256, 261, 347) carry the asterisk, but 46 additional rows (mostly 2000-2011) also have populated HKO cross-check columns without an asterisk in the source. hko_listed in this JSON is set to true whenever the HKO columns are populated, regardless of asterisk, since that is the verifiable signal of an independent cross-check; the asterisk subset is a further, stricter 'occurred within HK territory' designation not separately encoded here. depth_km/hko_depth_km use the string "<1" for the 3 rows (415, 416, 436) where the source table literally prints "< 1" km (i.e. sub-1km hypocentral depth) rather than a numeric value — this preserves the source's genuine non-numeric entry rather than fabricating a number.
